analytics.name: Analytic 1646
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Software Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: PackageManager.getInstalledPackages() or getInstalledApplications() called by app NOT IN $AppEnumAllowList$]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; Network Connection Creation via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: MDM agent, system diagnostic apps. Minimal.

log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: PackageManager.getInstalledPackages() or getInstalledApplications() called by app NOT IN $AppEnumAllowList$

log_sources.name: android:EMM
log_sources.channel: Managed package inventory/status and package metadata

analytics.name: Analytic 1647
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Software Discovery by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: UIApplication.canOpenURL() called > $URLProbeThreshold$ times with schemes NOT declared in app's LSApplicationQueriesSchemes within $ProbeWindow$]; Application State via Apple MDM [InstalledApplicationList / ManagedApplicationList]; Network Connection Creation via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 10 undeclared scheme probes within window. iOS enforces 50-probe limit total.

log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: UIApplication.canOpenURL() called > $URLProbeThreshold$ times with schemes NOT declared in app's LSApplicationQueriesSchemes within $ProbeWindow$

log_sources.name: iOS:NetworkExtension
log_sources.channel: NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata
